data.long_meaning: Angus is a Scottish name derived from the Gaelic word 'angus', meaning 'one-choice' or 'unique'. The name carries a strong and individualistic meaning, emphasizing self-determination and uniqueness. The name Angus carries the meaning “One-choice, strong” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Angus usually hope their child will grow to embody one-choice, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Angus total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Angus holds a spiritual significance as a reminder of God's unique and personal choice in calling each person into His divine plan for their lives. It is a call to live a life of self-determination and individualism, anchored in God's love and grace.
